text: Make me like you.
You will be like us. Like us.
No!
What is Goddard?
He's right there, Controller. He's a scientist, an expert on your people.
I don't know what he's babbling about, Controller. There's only me here, quite harmless.
Controller, the conversion is underway.
Oh, Mr. Carey. What have they done to you?
Be silent.
You know your chum, Savage there? She killed Wrenchard. Remember him?
This conversation is unimportant, you will-
Controller, I walked into something.
There is nothing there.
What are you talking about? She's just lumbered into Goddard.
Administrator!
Goddard is invisible to cyber technology. Alter your receptor wavelengths now.
Nice one, Isherwood.
There!
That is Goddard.
What is that he is carrying?
An organic techno-virus.
I'd destroy it now, if I were you.
Doctor!
What does it do?
Dissolves all cyber implants, totally eradicating all cyber technology.
Transmittable by touch.
One spill on just you, or Savage, or Carey, or anyone else, and it'll spread through you all like wildfire.
We are the last of the cyber race.
To destroy us would mean you were committing genocide.
Article 7 of your own constitutional law expressly forbids that.
How awful.
Awfully well-informed, you are, Cyber-Controller.
Maybe he wouldn't use it, Controller, but I would.
Now tell this one to let go of me, or I drop it here and now.
Release him!
Thank you. Now back away from me.
Isherwood, I can't think of one good reason to save your neck, but I'm going to do so anyway.
Go back through the portal and get to the mother ship.
But the temporal wave will go out there in about five minutes.
Then I suggest you run, very fast.
Goddard, look out!
Ha ha! You don't-
You don't quite know what you're up against, do you?
Do not move, Doctor.
Controller, take the file of the virus.
Commander, analyze this.
Oh, Doctor, just for once, I could do with a bit of saving right now.
If you kill me, Controller, you destroy your only route away from here.
We have your companion. She can pilot your craft.
But you can't get to it. You'll die.
The female will pilot it back home.
What? Forward from the 33rd century to wherever here is?
She's good, Controller, but she's not that good. Even I am not always that good.
She will have cyber technology to aid her. It will not present a problem.
Not a problem? The TARDIS is a marvelous machine.
More living, instinctive, and self-aware than you are.
No matter what you force Evelyn to do, the TARDIS will make sure it ends up somewhere else.
Is that true, Doctor?
Well, it's the excuse I always use on myself.
Controller, scans of this Goddard show he is not human.
What are you, Goddard?
Him? Oh, he's no different from Cary Savage and the others. He's a Cyberman, Administrator.
What? That's not possible. Are you from the future, too?
No, no, Administrator. I'm about 1300 years old.
She's talking.
I thought you were going to kill us.
You have convinced me otherwise.
Really?
Or is it the fact that Savage there has analyzed the virus?
The Doctor was correct, Controller. The liquid is a nanite-based retrovirus specifically designed to destroy our cybernetic systems. Yet it has cyber-technological origins.
Excellent.
Excellent? What are you talking about, Controller? It's going to destroy you.
You are wrong. Trooper, take them to the conversion chamber. Hold them there. Yes, Controller.
Convert that one.
No, but we had a deal.
Dismantle that one.
Great, thanks.
And me?
I will consider your future. Take them.
No! No! What about our plan?
Delay the conversion process on the Doctor's companion.
Yes, Controller.
I have a new plan.
Oh, thank goodness. Oh, my jaw.
It aches. Feels as though I've been to the dentist.
The process has been temporarily halted.
Thank you, Mr. Carey.
Do you remember me?
Yes. Yes, of course I do.
Wrenshard. Do you remember Wrenshard?
Yes. Yes, I do. He's your friend.
He has been terminated.
Oh. Oh, dear.
Why? Why am I aware of this?
Aware? Oh, why are you thinking about that? Well, because he was your friend. How did he die?
The Commander killed him. Why?
I don't know. Perhaps you should ask her.
I will do that.
Any chance you could get me out of this contraption first? Hello? Hello?
Excellent. Reversal complete. Commander.
Controller.
Reactivate conversion chamber.
Number four.
Yes, Controller. Deleted. I am activating chamber eight as well.
No. No. Please.
Excellent.
Goddard, we have to get Isshuud out of there.
You get him out. I plan to complete my mission.
You will be silent.
Come on up, Trooper. Why did you kill Wrenshard?
Query your query.
Why did you kill me?
My friend, Trooper. Something is wrong with your programming. You need...
Time to go, Goddard.
I have to get the file of the virus.
The Controller will have destroyed it by now. You get Isshuud. I'll find Evelyn.
Do it, man.
All right. Hold on, Administrator. Hold on.
No. I'm connected to the cyber systems.
Oh, my God.
Keep talking to me.
You remain where you are.
Hello, Nikki. Exhausted, are we?
Ripping the guts out of Query must have taken it out of you, eh?
Here, let me help you.
Help!
I'm sorry, Nikki. Let me get the plate off from around your eyes so you can see properly for the last time.
It's better this way.
Goddard?
Administrator, I'll have you out soon.
No. No. Kill me.
Why?
I'm already a Cyberman.
Not that. But listen. I can understand all the Cyber Command circuits.
Hear their words in my head.
Knew you'd come to get me.
Come on. Come on. Let's get you out of there.
Didn't turn me into a Cyberman after...
Oh, something's going on. Machinery's still running.
Oh, blow this. I'll have to heave these tubes out of the sarcophagus.
I wish I had the strength of ten men right now.
Come on, Evelyn. We only have a few seconds before...
Try stopping me, Controller.
Doctor.
This way. Run.
I can't. I'm fast.
You have to. Goddard. Isherwood. We have to leave. Now.
Isherwood is... I made it quick. But there's something you need to know.
Not now. Remember that sabotage I did?
Yes.
I reversed the portal's power servitors.
The temporal wave won't be going out onto the planet.
It'll come in here, destroying everything in less than a minute.
Stop.
Oh, Doctor.
You will be destroyed.
Go on, Evelyn. Go through.
I... I... I can't.
No, Doctor. No.
I'll come back for you, Goddard.
Doctor, wait. Isherwood told me about the virus.
The Controller did as you thought. Reversed it. He's...
You will die.
Reversed it and infected Evelyn. She's carrying the virus that made me...
Destroyed. Destroyed.
You made me destroyed.
Destroyed? Destroyed?
Try me, Controller. You made me... You destroyed my people.
Destroyed.
See if you can breathe without this, Controller.
You think you're God?
Well, I'm your child.
I'm your Adam.
I'm chucking you out of here.
Let's take your faceplate off.
Look upon my face with your own eyes one last time.
No. It can't be.
Evelyn.
Destroyed.
I'm sorry I was no use.
Nonsense. I'm sorry you had to go through that.
What about the others?
Goddard was yelling something as I dragged you through the portal. I couldn't hear him.
Then the temple wave hit them, and when I looked back, the portal just showed a flat rock wall.
They were all destroyed, then.
Yes. I'm afraid so.
But Goddard succeeded, it seems.
Now, let's have a look.
Yes. The mothership appears to be still in orbit, which means time hasn't diverged, and his timeline has been eradicated, as he wanted.
The Controller never got the chance to use the virus, either.
I need to lie down.
Yes, you do that. And when you wake up, I'll have a spot of lunch ready, and we can go somewhere less exhausting.
Poor Goddard. He studied our version of history, you know, just to make sure he fitted in.
We talked quite a bit. He seemed a nice young man at first.
Oh, I'm sorry, Evelyn. Everywhere we go, you get to know people, and then they die.
That's not fair on you.
Listen, without wishing to appear callous, you stopped me becoming a Cyberman. For that, I'm grateful.
But, um, can we go somewhere special?
Ah, where would you like?
In honor of Dr. Goddard, I'd like to go and see Charles Lindbergh make his historic flight.
St. Louis, 1927, it is. You have a rest, and when you wake up...
We'll be there.
1927. Sounds refreshingly peaceful.
